subject: Konduit pilot - metrics workback & kickoff logistics
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@konduit.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Konduit pilot - metrics workback & kickoff logistics

Hi Alex — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can lock the pilot window. Please confirm any changes by EOD tomorrow so we can provision and share the onboarding artifacts.

High-level pilot goal
- Validate Konduit’s conversational scoring and routing at production-adjacent scale while measuring latency, throughput and token economics.

Proposed success metrics (agreed during call)
- Latency: P95 infer latency (512-token prompt) <= 300 ms end-to-end within the VPC test environment
- Throughput: sustained 60 req/s for 30-minute sustained window (no more than 10% error rate)
- Cost: effective cost <= $0.006 per input token (measured across sampled traffic with Redwood billing instrumentation)
- Quality: 90%+ intent-match accuracy on the Konduit test set (n=1,200 labelled utterances) and no critical safety/regression failures

Evaluation plan & instrumentation
- Konduit provides a 1,200-utterance labelled test set and a 48-hour production traffic sample (anonymized). (Attachment: konduit_sample_schema.csv)
- Redwood will instrument token-level cost, per-request latency traces, and throughput dashboards (we’ll share RBAC links).
- Quality evaluation will run locally against your labels and using our automatic intent-match script; we’ll snapshot outputs and provide examples for manual review.

Timeline (target)
- Week 0 (Nov 22): Kickoff, data handoff, RDC provisioning
- Week 1 (Nov 23–29): Smoke tests + baseline latency/throughput runs
- Week 2 (Nov 30–Dec 6): Iterative tuning (batching/quantization), rerun measurements
- Week 3 (Dec 7–13): Quality review & final acceptance run
- Week 4 (Dec 14–20): Post-pilot readout and decision meeting

Owners
- Konduit: Priya Rao — dataset handoff & label clarifications
- Redwood Infra: Ben Carter — ded. pool provisioning, runbook, cost telemetry
- Redwood Trial Lead: Irene Choi — evaluation plan, acceptance decision, stakeholder readout

Immediate asks (please):
1) Confirm the labelled set delivery format and expected delivery date (CSV export preferred).
2) Confirm Konduit legal/procurement contact for the pilot paperwork (we’ll send a short MPA + SOW).
3) Confirm pilot start week (we propose Nov 22).

Attachments: konduit_sample_schema.csv, konduit_requirements_packet.pdf (security & connectivity checklist)

Thanks — I’ll provision the initial runbook and a short onboarding doc once you confirm the dataset format.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@konduit.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@konduit.ai>, procurement@konduit.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Konduit pilot - metrics workback & kickoff logistics

Irene — thanks for the recap and the clear plan. All looks mostly aligned. A few clarifications from our side: 
- The cost target looks aggressive given our current token mix; can we treat $0.006/token as a target and include a tolerable band up to $0.0075 for initial runs while we optimize?
- For latency, we’d like P95 <= 350 ms for the first smoke window, with the 300 ms target as the final acceptance gate after tuning.

We can deliver the labelled set as CSV by Nov 24 and share a 48-hour anonymized sample by Nov 25. Procurement (procurement@konduit.ai) will expect a one-page SOW and an MPA; they can sign DocuSign.

Nov 22 kickoff works on our end — can we schedule a 60-min kickoff at 10:00 AM PT? I’ll have Priya and our infra lead on the call.

On another note, we’ll upload a small example of your traffic shape this afternoon (will reference your sample schema).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Torres | Head of Product | Konduit

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Konduit pilot - metrics workback & kickoff logistics

Looping in operational items — I’ll provision a Dedicated pool scoped to Konduit with conservative autoscaling and enable prefix caching for the initial runs. ETA for provision: Nov 20 COB. I’ll also prepare the runbook (redwood_pilot_runbook.md) and link dashboards to the Konduit RBAC group.

Action items for infra
- Provision GPU nodes and baseline image (gpt-3.5q-optimized) — Ben
- Generate cost estimates for both $0.006 and $0.0075 token targets — Ben/Finance
- Share runbook and acceptance checklist by Nov 19 — Marissa

Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@konduit.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@konduit.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@konduit.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Konduit pilot - metrics workback & kickoff logistics

Alex/Priya — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirmed: Nov 22 kickoff at 10:00 AM PT. I’ve added a tentative calendar invite (link: https://cal.com/redwood/konduit-kickoff-60m) — please accept when you can.

We’ll proceed with the plan and treat $0.006/token as the optimization target with an initial tolerance to $0.0075 during tuning. Ben — thank you, please send the runbook and dashboards by Nov 19 as noted.

I’ll also send the one-page SOW and short MPA to procurement for signature (DocuSign link to follow). Looking forward to getting this moving next week — we’ll be in touch with the provisioning notes once ready.

Best,
Irene
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
